headline: Vail Resorts (MTN) Following New Board Appointment Is The Stock Fairly Valued
summary: Vail Resorts (MTN) is back in focus after the company appointed MGM Resorts International chief executive William Hornbuckle to its board, expanding the board to ten directors effective August 3, 2026.
